CREATE PROC [d360].[SP_hash_log_ATM] AS
BEGIN
CREATE TABLE #tbl
WITH
( DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN
)
AS
SELECT  ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS Sequence
,       [name]
,       'WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT convert(float,COUNT(*)) COUNT_TGT, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.'+name+' WHERE H = ''D''
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM
)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,''F-'','''') COUNT_SRC, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.'+name+' WHERE H <> ''D''
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)

INSERT INTO [d360].[HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,''_SRC'','''') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT *
FROM CTE12
) src

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC )
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT )
) pvt2' 
 AS sql_code
FROM    sys.tables  WHERE NAME LIKE 'STG_%' and schema_id = 9 and name not like '%logging' and name  in ('STG_ATM_CARD'
,'STG_ATM_CARDACCOUNT'
,'STG_ATM_CASHBANKACCOUNT'
,'STG_ATM_CASHCARD'
,'STG_ATM_CASHCARDACCMAPPING'
,'STG_ATM_CASHCARDACCOUNT'
,'STG_ATM_CLIENT'
,'STG_ATM_CLIENTCARDMAPPING'
,'STG_ATM_CUSTOMER'
,'STG_ATM_ISSCARD'
--,'STG_ATM_TRANSACTIONLOG'
)
;


DECLARE @nbr_statements INT = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #tbl)
,       @i INT = 1
;

WHILE   @i <= @nbr_statements
BEGIN
    DECLARE @sql_code NVARCHAR(4000) = (SELECT sql_code FROM #tbl WHERE Sequence = @i);
    EXEC    sp_executesql @sql_code;
    SET     @i +=1;
END

DROP TABLE #tbl;

WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT convert(numeric(25,5),COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),ACN_BALANCE_1)),0) ACN_BALANCE_1_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),ACN_BALANCE_2)),0) ACN_BALANCE_2_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),ACN_BALANCE_3)),0) ACN_BALANCE_3_tgt
, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_ATM_ACCOUNT WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM

)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,'F-','') COUNT_src
,convert(numeric(25,5),ACN_BALANCE_1) ACN_BALANCE_1_src
,convert(numeric(25,5),ACN_BALANCE_2) ACN_BALANCE_2_src
,convert(numeric(25,5),ACN_BALANCE_3) ACN_BALANCE_3_src
, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_ATM_ACCOUNT WHERE H <> 'D'
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT
,ACN_BALANCE_1_tgt
,ACN_BALANCE_2_tgt
,ACN_BALANCE_3_tgt
,ACN_BALANCE_1_src
,ACN_BALANCE_2_src
,ACN_BALANCE_3_src
, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)


INSERT INTO [d360].[HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT 
 CAST(COUNT_SRC as NUMERIC(25,5)) as COUNT_SRC
,CAST(COUNT_TGT as NUMERIC(25,5)) as COUNT_TGT
,CAST(ACN_BALANCE_1_tgt as NUMERIC(25,5)) as ACN_BALANCE_1_tgt
,CAST(ACN_BALANCE_2_tgt as NUMERIC(25,5)) as ACN_BALANCE_2_tgt
,CAST(ACN_BALANCE_3_tgt as NUMERIC(25,5)) as ACN_BALANCE_3_tgt
,CAST(ACN_BALANCE_1_src as NUMERIC(25,5)) as ACN_BALANCE_1_src
,CAST(ACN_BALANCE_2_src as NUMERIC(25,5)) as ACN_BALANCE_2_src
,CAST(ACN_BALANCE_3_src as NUMERIC(25,5)) as ACN_BALANCE_3_src
,FILE_NAME
,INSERT_DTTM
,DATE
FROM CTE12
) pvt

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC
,ACN_BALANCE_1_src
,ACN_BALANCE_2_src
,ACN_BALANCE_3_src )
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT
,ACN_BALANCE_1_tgt
,ACN_BALANCE_2_tgt
,ACN_BALANCE_3_tgt )
) pvt2
 
WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','');

END
GO
